title: Rosebud
writer: Erik Lee Preminger, Joan Hemingway, Paul Bonnecarrère
actors: Peter O'Toole, Richard Attenborough, Cliff Gorman
plot: Renowned producer-director Otto Preminger captures international terrorism in this film about five teenage girls who are kidnapped from a yacht by the P.L.O. Stars Peter O'Toole and Richard Attenborough.
